chapter: Musicians and ragtime bands of the time
title: Jules Cassard and the late Yellow Nunez
summary: He asks after Jules Cassard, names old colleagues, and says Yellow Nunez died around 1931.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Tell me something. Is Jules Casdard living yet?
Yes. Yes. He travels with the races or something.

That's what I would, yeah. Yeah. Somebody's on. Jules and I all keep together. Started out Jules Casdard. Henry Brunas. Well, Henry came after. He was here. Eddie Edwards. And what's his name that died? Yellow Lunez. Remember what? Yellow Lunez.
I've got lots of his records.
Yeah. Well, what happened to him? He died. He came back. Do you know when about? Big one? About when did he die? Or do you know much about him?
Those people that aren't living were sort of interested in them, you know, because they can't speak for themselves. Yeah, yeah.
